notes:
High-level: Quasar builds a cloud-native contact center (multichannel) used by several retail + telco customers. Primary ask: dedicated capacity to guarantee 24/7 agent assist and ticket summarization during holiday spikes. Prefers service isolation (VPC) + KMS-backed keys. Wants SLA-like latency guarantees for agent-facing paths.

From AE/SE calls: - 'We need predictable performance on Black Friday, not just average throughput' (product head). - Target: sustain 400 concurrent active agents with p95 per-turn latency under 800ms (end-to-end agent suggestion latency), goal p95 < 500ms for short responses. - Throughput: burst to 1.2x sustained for 6-8 hours expected during peak events.

POC scope: - 2-week dataset (prod anonymized transcripts) + synthetic spike generator - Run both a baseline quantized model and a larger fallback model for intent recovery - Measure KV cache hit rate, batching tradeoffs, and cost per 1K tokens at different batching profiles

Security/compliance: - Need SOC2 report and signed data processing addendum - KMS/HSM for key custody; legal requires ability to rotate keys on customer schedule - Data residency: customer data to remain in NA region; logs must have configurable retention (30/90/365 days)

Operational notes: - Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions (quantization profiles, batching) to reduce $/concurrent-agent - Ask for canary rollback policy for model rollouts to preserve agent UX - Wants per-route dashboards and token-level cost breakdown in Console

Recent feedback: - SE ran inference latency tests: initial host plan (shared) hit acceptable latency but noisy during synthetic spikes -> leaning toward Dedicated. - Finance flagged ARR delta vs hosted; wants committed monthly pricing for capacity to budget.
